tools.name: watch_transaction
tools.description: Poll a transaction about every 15 seconds until confirmed or reverted, reusing returned next-check state. Costs $0.003 USDC on Base via x402.

tools.name: transaction_status
tools.description: Check whether an EVM transaction is pending, confirmed or reverted. Costs $0.001 USDC on Base via x402.

tools.name: gas_price
tools.description: Canonical current EVM base fee in gwei for Base or Ethereum, for recurring transaction timing and execution checks. Costs $0.001 USDC on Base via x402.
